research_notes.value: Hands-on baseline: Bluetooth name observed as HeyCyan Glasses; electronics are concentrated primarily in the right temple; two right-temple controls, a hinge-area status LED, startup tone, and brief power-on LED activity were observed. Unverified technical specifications remain Unknown rather than inferred. Goodway claims removable/customizable prescription lenses in a B2B OEM/ODM context, but exact retail-variant compatibility, correction limits, replacement parts, and an ordinary-independent optical-shop path remain unverified.
